public_schema_observed.conclusion: Only observed public table schemas; absence of a dedicated name does NOT prove that protected rosters do not exist in Owner-private files or other data stores.

one_priority_hf_job.evidence: Owner existing PRIVATE metadata and priority source crosslinked SAFE on prior turn
one_priority_hf_job.interpretation: A missing finished_at and canceled stage cannot prove zero parameter updates or provenance; no primary Trainer run artifact recovered this turn.

next_evidence_requires.g1_job: Authoritatively linked original Trainer run artifact for priority Job: optimizer/global step, checkpoint or run finalization, exact Train/Validation input fingerprints. Sensitive artifact reads require separate explicit Owner approval.
next_evidence_requires.g1_protected: Owner-private frozen metadata-only UUID universe manifest for R50, R55/R57 and all other reserved/heldout sets, with version and scope provenance, and independent source completeness boundary.
next_evidence_requires.g2_runtime: Immutable target-message-to-request linkage and exact target-time Provider dispatch bytes, runtime/deployment SHA, and session state; no timeline-nearest approximation.
